description:
An exceptional three/four bedroom detached family home situated within a cul-de-sac location with versatile accommodation and generous gardens.

DESCRIPTION
Occupying a desirable cul-de-sac position on the edge of the popular Moorhayes development, 10 Honeysuckle Close is a beautifully presented three/four-bedroom detached family home offering generous and versatile living accommodation, driveway parking for three cars and attractive enclosed gardens.

Previously configured as a four-bedroom property, the former owners have combined Bedrooms 3 and 4 to create an impressive guest bedroom, although the original layout could be easily reinstated to suit growing families. The property benefits from a substantial sitting room, created from the former double garage, with potential for a first-floor extension above, subject to the necessary planning consents.

The accommodation is both spacious and flexible, with a useful porch leading you to the welcoming entrance hall with access to a cloakroom, fitted with WC, wash hand basin and heated towel rail and storage cupboard with radiator perfect for drying clothes. To the front of the property, the dining room enjoys a bay window and feature fireplace, creating an ideal setting for formal dining.

The heart of the home is the impressive kitchen/breakfast room, enjoying views over the rear garden and fitted with an extensive range of matching wall and base units, complemented by a central island with electric sockets, wine rack, additional storage and breakfast bar seating. Integrated appliances include a fridge/freezer and dishwasher, while there is space for a range cooker. The adjoining breakfast area offers plenty of room for everyday dining.

Leading from the kitchen is a well-equipped utility room with further storage, space and plumbing for laundry appliances, and direct access to the garden through french doors.

The standout feature of the property is the superb sitting room. Converted from the original double garage, this reception space offers generous proportions, a feature electric fireplace, and French doors opening onto the rear garden. In addition, the summer room provides a versatile and light-filled space, overlooking the gardens and benefitting from two sets of sliding doors, making it ideal as a family room, garden room, or entertaining area.

On the first floor, the spacious principal bedroom enjoys a front aspect, fitted wardrobes, and an en-suite shower room with shower, WC, wash hand basin and heated towel rail. Bedroom Two is a comfortable double room with fitted wardrobes and a rear outlook. Bedroom Three has been enlarged by combining two bedrooms and now offers a substantial double room with fitted wardrobes and views over the rear garden. The family bathroom is fitted with a modern suite comprising a freestanding bath with shower attachment, WC, wash hand basin and heated towel rail. From the first floor landing the loft can be accessed, which is boarded with ladder lighting and power sockets.

SITUATION
The property is situated in the popular residential area known as Moorhayes on the edge of Tiverton with a small range of shops including Tesco Express. Tiverton provides an excellent range of shopping, banking, recreational healthcare and educational facilities. Easy commuting via the North Devon Link Road either to the north coast via Barnstaple or eastward back to the M5 (J27) and Parkway mainline railway station. Exeter lies some 18 miles to the south and offers a more comprehensive range of facilities as befitting a Cathedral City and Taunton, the County Town of Somerset lies approximately 19 miles to the north, again offering a varied and comprehensive range of facilities.

OUTSIDE
To the front of the property, a private driveway provides off-road parking for numerous vehicles and benefits from an EV charging point. The front garden has been designed for ease of maintenance, with a combination of paving, decorative chippings, and established shrubs. Useful storage areas that run the full length of both sides the property with light and power.

The enclosed rear garden provides a wonderful outdoor space for families and entertaining alike. Predominantly laid to lawn, with raised planted borders and vegetable patch, it also features an elevated composite decking area ideal for al fresco dining and summer gatherings. Completing the garden is an attractive summerhouse which is currently used as a gym, it comes with electric lighting, electric heating, TV aerial and WIFI. with adjoining wooden pergola, creating the perfect spot to relax and enjoy the surroundings.
